verdict.rationale: Bento documents visual workflows and lets users "check every branch before it runs," but that is a pre-run check of a flow. It is not version history or change review. Nothing in the evidence shows workflow versioning, diff/review of changes, or rolling back to a prior automation version. Separate production and testing Sites are an adjacent arrangement, not versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
